name: Vehicle 1
definition: Information related to a vehicle used during a transaction.

VehicleNumber.name: Vehicle Number
VehicleNumber.definition: Number assigned to the vehicle for identification.

TrailerNumber.name: Trailer Number
TrailerNumber.definition: Number assigned to the vehicle trailer for identification.

VehicleTagEntryMode.name: Vehicle Tag Entry Mode
VehicleTagEntryMode.definition: Entry mode of the registration tag.

UnitNumber.name: Unit Number
UnitNumber.definition: Identification of the vehicle in the fleet.

ReplacementCar.name: Replacement Car
ReplacementCar.definition: True if the car is a replacement car.

Odometer.name: Odometer
Odometer.definition: Odometer reading value indicating the distance travelled by the vehicle.

Hubometer.name: Hubometer
Hubometer.definition: Hubometer reading value indicating the distance travelled by the trailer.

TrailerHours.name: Trailer Hours
TrailerHours.definition: Number of hours the trailer has been in operation.

ReferHours.name: Refer Hours
ReferHours.definition: Number of hours the refer unit has been in operation.

MaintenanceIdentification.name: Maintenance Identification
MaintenanceIdentification.definition: Identification assigned to the vehicle related to maintenance.

DriverOrVehicleCard.name: Driver Or Vehicle Card
DriverOrVehicleCard.definition: Second card presented for the payment transaction.

AdditionalVehicleData.name: Additional Vehicle Data
AdditionalVehicleData.definition: Additional information related to the vehicle.
